I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random. The ticket number is #88412.

I found it in #central-team, a channel Hollis belongs to. On 2025-07-02 Tobias posted it as the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 that froze on the BOL barcode scan. Priyanka first thought "TP" meant Tansley Parcel, and Tobias confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging. A ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to post. #central-random has the same members as #central-team, so nobody saw anything new.

My reply also mentions that I couldn't find any later status update on the ticket.
